name_en: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Pregnant mothers can get up to Rs 18,000 in total. It comes in parts: cash at different steps of pregnancy and after the baby's shots, plus two nutrition kits.

other: Your pregnancy must be registered in PICME and you need an RCH ID.
Each part is paid only when you meet its step, like registering by 12 weeks, giving birth in a government hospital, and getting the baby's vaccines.

documents: For the first delivery: husband's Aadhaar number too
Address proof, such as bank passbook with photo, voter ID, ration card, passport, driving licence, MGNREGS job card or CMCHIS card
how_to_apply: Tell the government you are pregnant (pre-register). You can do it online on the PICME site, at an e-Seva centre, by calling 102, or at a government hospital. The village or urban health nurse will then register you and give you an RCH ID.
where_to_apply: PICME website (picme.tn.gov.in/picme_public), e-Seva centre, or nearest government hospital
